Marco Rubio India visit LIVE updates: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio will be visiting the Jamnagar refinery, owned by Reliance industries. Marco Rubio India visit LIVE updates: US secretary of state Marco Rubio will visit the Reliance Industries-owned Jamnagar Refinery in Gujarat on Wednesday, with a focus on global energy security. The US is looking to ask Reliance Industries to refine more Venezuelan crude as America seeks to bring additional supplies to a market rattled by the Iran conflict, reported Bloomberg. ...Read More
The refinery is the largest in the country, with an installed capacity of 1.4 million barrels per day. Rubio is on a two-day visit to India. On the first day of his visit, October 20, he met India's external affairs minister S Jaishankar in Mumbai. The two reviewed bilateral cooperation, focusing on energy and defence, as Rubio urged India to increase energy trade with the US and step up purchases of American technologies and systems. This is Rubio’s second visit to India in less than five months, and he is accompanied by a large business delegation. Following the meeting, Jaishankar said in a social media post that the two sides discussed ways to further advance their ties, with a focus on “trade, energy, technology, defence and people-to-people ties”. They also exchanged views on regional developments. According to a readout issued by the US State Department spokesperson, Rubio urged India to increase its purchases of American energy, technologies, and military and nuclear equipment. Rubio “reiterated that increased energy trade with the United States can play a transformative role in diversifying India’s supply chains while meeting its sizable consumer demand,” the readout said. He also commended progress in bilateral defence and civil nuclear cooperation and “advocated for the increased purchase of US technologies and systems, which can enhance the security and prosperity of both our countries”.
Marco Rubio India visit LIVE updates: Rubio’s visit to the Jamnagar refinery comes as Washington urges India to diversify its energy imports away from Russia and seeks markets for increased Venezuelan oil production.
Rubio said on Tuesday that he would discuss expanding the processing of Venezuelan oil with Reliance Industries. He added that India could help boost global oil supplies as Venezuela’s crude production rises, describing India as a “refining superpower”.
“They have the capability to refine heavy crude. They’ve done so in the past, and I think as more and more Venezuelan oil comes online, it’s something they can do,” Rubio told reporters in Mumbai on Tuesday. “Energy is related to national security. You know, countries fight wars over energy, as an example. Economies collapse over lack of energy. So we’re going to go see a company that has a tremendous amount of refining capability, so it makes all the sense in the world to talk to them about it,” Rubio said.
Marco Rubio India visit LIVE updates: United States President Donald Trump has said that New Delhi and Washington are “pretty close” to finalising a trade deal, even as US Secretary of State Marco Rubio is in India on a three-day official visit. More here
On October 20, India and the US reviewed their bilateral cooperation, with the focus on energy and defence, as US secretary of state Marco Rubio urged India to increase energy trade and step up purchases of American technologies and systems. Read more here
Rubio is scheduled to visit Reliance’s Jamnagar refining complex in Gujarat on Wednesday. The US is looking to persuade India’s Reliance Industries Ltd. to refine more Venezuelan crude as Washington seeks to bring additional supplies to a market rattled by the Iran conflict.
The possibility will be discussed with Reliance when US Secretary of State Marco Rubio meets with Chairman Mukesh Ambani and his team, Rubio told reporters on Tuesday, shortly after arriving in Mumbai for a three-day trip, Bloomberg reported.
